UI_QoLforSacriel_ModuleDisabled: Module is disabled in sandbox settings.
UI_QoLforSacriel_EquipmentTogglePresetTo: Toggles this preset between equip and unequip mode.
UI_QoLforSacriel_EquipmentAddAllCurrentP: adds currently worn protective gear and equipped weapon-category items to this preset, clearing anything that was here before
UI_QoLforSacriel_EquipmentMannequinUnava: You cannot interact with this mannequin right now.
This preset has no gear for a mannequin.
You do not have a matching preset item available.

UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableMod_Toolt: Master switch for every QoL for Sacriel feature.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_DebugLogs_Toolt: Writes extra diagnostic logs for troubleshooting module behavior.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableUIFixes_T: Turns the entire UI Fixes group on or off at runtime.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableSkillFilt: Shows the optional skill list filter in the character info panel.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableExteriorV: Allows honking from the open or broken driver-side window using the vanilla horn key or vehicle radial menu.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_SkillFilterRece: How long, in game minutes, a skill stays marked as recently trained. Default 60.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_SkillFilterMinF: Minimum full skill level shown by the strict filter mode. Valid range: 0-10. Default 2.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableWaterDept: Shows per-tile water amount overlay hints while using the Water search focus.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableForagingR: Adds an Investigate Area selector for normal, hidden, or color-coded physical world-item pins.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableForagingV: Shows QoL radius contributors in the Investigate Area Vision Effectiveness tooltip.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableForagingC: Restores vanilla Search Mode penalties for SCBA, masks, eyewear, and full head coverings. Disabled by default because it changes gameplay.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_ForagingRefinem: Color used for physical world-item pins when Investigate Area is set to Yellow.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableOrganized: Adds tagged-container unloading controls to the Inventory and Loot Window footers.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_ShowOrganizedIn: Show Organized Inventory Tags in Tooltips
Shows the ordered specific Organized Inventory tags an item can match during unloading.
UI_QoLforSacriel_OrganizedInventoryNoDes: No tagged nearby container is available.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_WaterDepthShowL: When enabled, players with Foraging level above 3 see numeric liters (one decimal) instead of Shallow/Medium/Deep labels.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableHeavyLoad: Plays local hurt feedback when heavy-load damage is actively reducing health.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableFitnessNu: Adds a Fitness tab to Character Info with calorie balance and training nutrition indicators.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_ShowExactSleepS: Shows exact observed sleep recovery, duration, and onset values in the Fitness tab.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SleepQuality_Caveat: (not all early wake reasons detected, yet)
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableShowStats: Shows verified numeric item stats in inventory and crafting tooltips while preserving vanilla tooltip content and bars.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_ShowBasicWeapon: Limits weapon stats to Condition and Damage. Disabled shows all verified weapon stats.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableCraftReci: Shows each configured skill XP award in the selected crafting recipe information box.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableCraftTool: Adds a submenu for eligible vanilla inventory crafting recipes so you can choose which available tool is used.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableInventory: Enables inventory context workflow additions such as grab-all food actions and Eat chain actions.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableGrabAllRo: Adds a context action to transfer all rotten food from the active non-player container into player inventory.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableGrabAllSt: Adds a context action to transfer all stale (non-rotten) food from the active non-player container into player inventory.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableEatChainA: Adds an Eat submenu action that queues eating across all eligible selected food items.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableEatUntilN: Adds precise single-item eating plus stack actions that stop when hunger clears or vanilla's full limit is reached.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableHeavyCraf: When heavy-load damage occurs right after crafting, auto-drops a recent crafted output item to floor to stop weight damage escalation.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableWashAllBl: Queues Wash All clothing from the greatest total blood level to the least.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableFishingNe: Adds eligible bait from reachable nearby containers to the fishing rod Add Bait menu.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableHeldItemP: Adds reachable nearby containers to the context menu for a held item.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_CraftToolSubmen: Craft Tool Submenu Max Tool Slots
Only recipes with this many tool input slots or fewer can expand into a tool-choice submenu. More complex recipes stay on the vanilla direct-action path.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_WaterDepthOverl: How many tiles around the player are scanned for water amount markers. Default 3, 5+ can affect FPS.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_WaterDepthShall: Per-tile water amount (liters) where overlay becomes Shallow. Valid range: 0-10L. Medium is inferred between shallow and deep.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_WaterDepthDeepM: Per-tile water amount (liters) where overlay becomes Deep. Valid range: 0-10L. Medium is inferred automatically.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableSoundDire: Allows the sound direction visualizer to run at runtime.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_SoundDirectionN: Detailed Sound Direction settings remain on the dedicated QoL Sound Direction page (below). Default off.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableNoiseRadi: Allows local player noise-radius marking to run at runtime.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_NoiseRadiusNote: Detailed Noise Radius settings remain on the dedicated QoL Noise Radius page. Default off.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableDragDrop_: Controls corpse dragging endurance compensation and related drag-drop tweaks.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_DragDropFatigue: Starting share of normal endurance loss while dragging a corpse.
Maximum share of normal endurance loss after the ramp completes.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_DragDropRampSec: Seconds it takes for drag fatigue to ramp from start multiplier to max multiplier.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableRestSleep: Adds and manages the Rest Until Sleepy quality-of-life action.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_RestSleepSleepy: Target fatigue value where automatic resting should stop.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_RestSleepInterr: Stops automated rest when movement input is detected.
Stops automated rest when panic rises past the configured threshold.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_RestSleepPanicI: Panic value that interrupts automatic rest when panic interrupt is enabled.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableEquipment: Turns the entire Armor preset system on or off.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EquipmentEnable: Enables preset save, toggle, and clear actions in inventory context menu and hotkeys. All items can be added manually, but only armor/weapons are added 'on add all
Shows Equipment Presets actions when right-clicking mannequins.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EquipmentPreset: How many equipment preset slots are exposed to the player.
Leave a name blank to use the default preset label.
Name shown in the Equipment Presets context menu. Maximum 12 characters.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EquipmentHotkey: Capture a keybind per preset. Modifier keys are captured directly in each preset keybind.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EquipmentPreset: Click and press the desired key combination for this preset.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableFurniture: Adds right-click nudge actions for eligible placed furniture.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_FurnitureNudgeK: Experimental: Keep Furniture Inventory When Nudging

Allows compatible storage furniture, including supported multi-tile furniture, to keep its inventory when nudged. Unexplored, powered, fluid, active-workstation, and other stateful furniture must still be emptied first.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_FurnitureNudgeE: Multiplier applied to weight-scaled endurance loss when nudging furniture.
Minimum endurance spent on a successful nudge.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_FurnitureNudgeB: When enabled, dropped floor items can block a nudge destination tile.
Block Nudge On Rugs And Carpets
When enabled, rugs and carpets can block a nudge destination tile.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_FurnitureNudgeA: Allows eligible multi-tile furniture to be nudged. Experimental and may fail on edge cases.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_FurnitureNudgeI: Ignores vanilla pickup/place tool requirements for Furniture Nudge actions only.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableLightSwit: Adds a hotkey to toggle the nearest valid light switch.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_LightSwitchTogg: Click and press the desired key combination. Default is Ctrl+F.
Tile radius to search for nearby light switches (including diagonals).
When enabled, only light switches in the same room are eligible.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableNearbyDev: Turns the nearby-device shutdown hotkey on or off.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_NearbyDeviceOff: Click and press the desired key combination. Default is Ctrl+G.
Tile radius to search for world and ground devices, including diagonals. Player inventory is always checked.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableHeldBagCl: Places held bags on the far side before climbing through windows or over fences.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableVehicleEn: When Interact is pressed beside a vehicle, turns toward a valid vehicle interaction area if vanilla has not found one. Does not bypass vehicle entry rules.
UI_QoLforSacriel_FurnitureNudgeKeepInven: enable Experimental: Keep Furniture Inventory or empty this furniture
UI_QoLforSacriel_FurnitureNudgeAppliance: turn off the appliance and wait for residual heat to clear; timed ovens must also have no timer
UI_QoLforSacriel_FurnitureNudgeSinglePla: keeping furniture inventory is available in single-player only
UI_QoLforSacriel_FurnitureNudgeCannotVer: the furniture state could not be verified
UI_QoLforSacriel_FurnitureNudgeCompoundU: this compound furniture cannot safely keep its inventory while nudging
UI_QoLforSacriel_FurnitureNudgeFluidAndI: furniture combining fluid and item storage cannot be nudged safely
UI_QoLforSacriel_FurnitureNudgeUnsupport: this furniture type cannot keep its inventory while nudging
UI_QoLforSacriel_FurnitureNudgeStatefulU: this furniture has state that cannot be preserved safely
UI_QoLforSacriel_FurnitureNudgeParallelW: cannot nudge parallel to nearby wall
UI_QoLforSacriel_FurnitureNudgeRequiresT: cannot nudge furniture that requires tools
UI_QoLforSacriel_FurnitureNudgeKeepInven: The furniture could not be moved safely. Its items were recovered to your inventory or nearby floor.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableSafeBever: Lets vanilla Auto Drink use safe non-alcoholic tea or coffee first. Water stays vanilla when no qualifying beverage is available. Single-player only.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableGroundCov: Replaces vanilla removal for logs, tree branches, and large stones with inventory and primary-hand choices.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableDismantle: Retains partial dismantling progress for eligible world objects after interruption, chunk reload, or save reload. Single-player only. Inventory dismantling is unchanged, and no extra progress indicator is shown.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableHearthRet: Adds a local heat trail to supported fireplaces after they are charged and their vanilla heat radius starts shrinking. Single-player only.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_HearthRetainedH: Base hours at 0C to reach full stored heat. Select 1 through 8 hours; default 4.
Base hours at 0C for the heat trail to cool from 35 to 12. Select 12 through 36 hours; default 24.
Timing adjustment at plus or minus 20C. Default 30. Values outside 0 to under 40 use the default.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableArmorMood: Reduces discomfort gain while wearing protective gear outside high-effort actions.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_ArmorMoodBaseRe: Fraction of discomfort gain removed while the armor effect is active. Default 0.95, use 1.0 for full removal.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_ArmorMoodUpdate: Minimum time between armor discomfort recalculations. To limit fps impact.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableDrySelfDi: Enable Dry Self Wetness Per Use
Uses the configured absolute wetness removal per towel use. When disabled, Dry Self uses vanilla behavior.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_DrySelfWetnessP: Dry Self Wetness Removed Per Towel Use
Absolute wetness removed on each towel-use tick. Default 6.25 removes 100 wetness in about 16 uses, or 80%% of a 20-use bath towel. Lower values use less towel; higher values dry faster.
UI_QoLforSacriel_FitnessStrength_Red: Protein is not near the Strength XP bonus range
UI_QoLforSacriel_FitnessStrength_Grey: Protein has no Strength XP modifier
UI_QoLforSacriel_FitnessStrength_Yellow: Protein is near the Strength XP bonus range
UI_QoLforSacriel_FitnessStrength_Purple: Protein is above the Strength XP bonus range
UI_QoLforSacriel_FitnessEndurance_Red: Fitness XP blocked by current weight trait
UI_QoLforSacriel_FitnessEndurance_Yellow: Fitness XP may be restricted by current weight
UI_QoLforSacriel_FitnessEndurance_Green: Fitness XP is allowed at current weight
UI_QoLforSacriel_FitnessXpBlocked: Fitness XP blocked by current weight trait
UI_QoLforSacriel_SkillFilterMode_MinLeve: Hide below X full level + recents
UI_QoLforSacriel_SkillFilterMode_Tooltip: Choose which skills are shown. The selection is saved with this player.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_PerformanceN: Single-player only. Enabling Sound Direction can reduce FPS, especially in busy areas.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_Enable_Toolt: Master switch for the single-player directional sound overlay.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_UseAmbientCo: Tries to enrich ambient cues using nearby world-sound events when both happen together.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_ZMarkerEnabl: Draws a small vertical marker when the sound came from another floor.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_EnableInferr: Adds best-effort zombie sound cues when no direct sound event is available.
Adds best-effort animal sound cues based on nearby animals when no direct sound event is available.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_ShowSourceLa: Displays a short text label next to each sound cue.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_ShowOutsideH: Shows sounds beyond your hearing radius in white so they can be distinguished from heard sounds.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_ArrowScale_T: Scales the size and offset of the directional arrow indicator.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_TriggerRando: Calls the vanilla random meta ambient trigger for testing sound detection.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_MaxTrackedCu: Maximum number of active sound cues kept in memory at once.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_CueDurationM: How long each sound cue remains visible before expiring.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundRadius_Performance: Single-player only. Marks observed local-player and world-object sound radii.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundRadius_Enable_Tool: Master switch for observed local-player and eligible world-object noise-radius rings.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundRadius_MaxActiveRi: Limits simultaneously visible noise-radius rings. Lower values reduce rendering work during repeated sounds.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundRadius_Duration_To: How long each noise-radius ring expands before expiring.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundRadius_Opacity_Too: Sets the maximum opacity of the expanding ring. The radius label stays readable.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundRadius_CullingMarg: Keeps ring geometry visible this many pixels beyond the player viewport. Use 0 for exact viewport intersection; higher values can cost performance.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundRadius_ShowRadiusL: Shows the raw world-sound radius in tiles next to the emission point.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundRadius_LabelFont_T: Sets the text size for displayed ring-radius labels.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_CategoryPlay: Shows world-sound cues sourced from players.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_CategoryEnvi: Shows environmental sounds such as wildlife and weather-derived cues.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_CategoryAlar: Shows alarms, sirens, generators, and similar alerting sound cues.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_CategoryMeta: Shows standalone meta-event cues such as meta wildlife, screams, and other ambient story sounds.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_CategoryUnkn: Shows cues that could not be classified into a known sound group.
